notes.title: v.0.2.0
notes.content:
A new version for our Beta testers submitted.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ztNMHNU.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Added Level 6 .
[*] Added Level 7.
[*] Added Level 1-B.
[*] Added Level 2-B.
[*] Added Level 3-B.
[*] Added Level 4-B.
[*] Added Level 5-B.
[*] Added Level 6-B.
[*] Added a gallery with all the unlocked comics.
[*] Added more sound effects to level 04.
[*] Added teddies to the load game menu.
[*] Added losing health during time on Arcade Mode.
[*] Added support to multiple players on the same keyboard.
[*] Improved Controls Options.
[*] Improved particles on Cavernator (level 03 and level 05 boss).
[*] Changed the way the droppable items behave on Level 03.
[*] Some minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.1.0
notes.content:
A new version for our Beta testers submitted.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/WXS0iZA.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added Level 5 .
[*] Added sound fx to Level 4.
[*] Added boss teddy bears when killing and hitting multiple time bosses.
[*] Added boss “bonus stage” to the Level 1 boss.
[*] Added Video Options.
[*] Added support to Keyboard and Controller on multiple players (The [*] keyboard should be always the last available player).
[*] Added color to comics.
[*] Updated FMOD to version 1.09.04.
[*] Improved rendering on invisible zones.
[*] Improved some texts translations to Spanish.
[*] Improved attack detection when hitting multiple enemies.
[*] Improved Jack’s axe collision to moving platforms.
[*] Improved Pterodactyl enemy on Level 2 hit boxes.
[*] Fixed bug where Liliana went through platforms when doing the super jump.
[*] Fixed bug where the buttons on the Main Menu didn’t work properly.
[*] Some other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: v.0.0.11
notes.content:
A new version for our Beta testers submitted.

[list]
[*] Added Level 4 with some sound sfx missing.
[*] Added Tutorial on Level 3
[*] Added language translations for Spanish & English
[*] Changed controller button icons to Xelu buttons
[*] Changed icon on level select when missing battery on level.
[*] Improved options menu
[*] Improved Player ground detection
[*] Fixed Bug where the player went outside the screen on the end cinematic at Level 3.
[*] Fixed Bug where the player freezes after being hit by an enemy
[*] Fixed Bug where Jack skill didn’t do damage to enemies.
[*] Fixed Bug where battery count on the level select didn’t update properly.
[*] Some other minor bug fixes
[/list]
